@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+/** `/squeeze ...`: parsing and argument completion. Pure: the handler in squeeze.ts acts on the result. */
+import type { Kind } from "../core/compact.ts";
+
+export type Command =
+	| { kind: "status" }
+	| { kind: "on" }
+	| { kind: "off" }
+	| { kind: "compactor"; compactor: Kind; on: boolean }
+	| { kind: "rtk"; on: boolean }
+	| { kind: "min"; chars: number }
+	| { kind: "invalid"; message: string };
+
+export const KINDS: Kind[] = ["search", "paths", "listing"];
+
+export const USAGE = "Usage: /squeeze [status] · on · off · search|paths|listing|rtk <on|off> · min <chars>";
+
+export function parseCommand(args: string | undefined): Command {
+	const [cmd, p1] = (args ?? "").trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
+	switch (cmd) {
+		case undefined:
+		case "status":
+			return { kind: "status" };
+		case "on":
+		case "enable":
+			return { kind: "on" };
+		case "off":
+		case "disable":
+			return { kind: "off" };
+		case "min": {
+			const n = Number(p1);
+			return Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 100 && n <= 1_000_000
+				? { kind: "min", chars: n }
+				: { kind: "invalid", message: "Usage: /squeeze min <chars> (100 to 1000000)" };
+		}
+		case "rtk":
+			return p1 === "on" || p1 === "off" ? { kind: "rtk", on: p1 === "on" } : { kind: "invalid", message: "Usage: /squeeze rtk <on|off>" };
+		default:
+			if ((KINDS as string[]).includes(cmd)) {
+				return p1 === "on" || p1 === "off"
+					? { kind: "compactor", compactor: cmd as Kind, on: p1 === "on" }
+					: { kind: "invalid", message: `Usage: /squeeze ${cmd} <on|off>` };
+			}
+			return { kind: "invalid", message: `Unknown option "${cmd}". ${USAGE}` };
+	}
+}
+
+export interface CompletionItem {
+	value: string;
+	/** Required by pi: it calls `label.endsWith(...)` when applying a completion. */
+	label: string;
+	description?: string;
+}
+
+const TOP_LEVEL: CompletionItem[] = [
+	{ value: "status", label: "status", description: "Show the settings and the savings" },
+	{ value: "on", label: "on", description: "Turn pi-squeeze on" },
+	{ value: "off", label: "off", description: "Turn it off (nothing is compacted)" },
+	{ value: "search ", label: "search", description: "rg / grep results grouped by file (on or off)" },
+	{ value: "paths ", label: "paths", description: "fd / find results grouped by directory (on or off)" },
+	{ value: "listing ", label: "listing", description: "lsd / eza -l listings (on or off)" },
+	{ value: "rtk ", label: "rtk", description: "Rewrite git, cargo, docker… through rtk, when installed (on or off)" },
+	{ value: "min ", label: "min", description: "Smallest output to compact, in characters" },
+];
+
+/** `prefix` is the whole argument text typed so far (pi replaces it with `value`). */
+export function completions(prefix: string): CompletionItem[] | null {
+	const text = (prefix ?? "").toLowerCase().replace(/^\s+/, "");
+	const kind = [...KINDS, "rtk"].find((k) => text.startsWith(`${k} `));
+	const pool: CompletionItem[] = kind
+		? [
+				{ value: `${kind} on`, label: "on", description: kind === "rtk" ? "Rewrite commands through rtk" : `Compact ${kind} output` },
+				{ value: `${kind} off`, label: "off", description: kind === "rtk" ? "Run commands as written" : `Leave ${kind} output alone` },
+			]
+		: TOP_LEVEL;
+	const out = pool.filter((i) => i.value.startsWith(text));
+	return out.length > 0 ? out : null;
+}
diff --git a/extensions/core/command.ts b/extensions/core/command.ts

+/**
+ * Reads a bash command line just far enough to know which program ran and with which
+ * arguments. Anything that reshapes the output (pipes, redirects, chains, substitution)
+ * makes it return undefined: the output is then not in the program's own format and
+ * must pass through untouched.
+ */
+
+export type Invocation = { program: string; args: string[] };
+
+const OPERATOR = /[|;&<>`]|\$\(/;
+
+/** Split on whitespace, honouring single/double quotes and backslash escapes. */
+export function tokenize(line: string): string[] | undefined {
+	const out: string[] = [];
+	let cur = "";
+	let has = false;
+	let quote: "'" | '"' | undefined;
+	for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
+		const c = line[i]!;
+		if (quote) {
+			if (c === quote) quote = undefined;
+			else if (c === "\\" && quote === '"' && i + 1 < line.length) cur += line[++i];
+			else cur += c;
+		} else if (c === "'" || c === '"') {
+			quote = c;
+			has = true;
+		} else if (c === "\\" && i + 1 < line.length) {
+			cur += line[++i];
+			has = true;
+		} else if (/\s/.test(c)) {
+			if (has || cur) out.push(cur);
+			cur = "";
+			has = false;
+		} else {
+			cur += c;
+			has = true;
+		}
+	}
+	if (quote) return undefined;
+	if (has || cur) out.push(cur);
+	return out;
+}
+
+/** True when `text` contains a shell operator outside quotes. */
+export function hasOperator(text: string): boolean {
+	let quote: "'" | '"' | undefined;
+	for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
+		const c = text[i]!;
+		if (quote) {
+			if (c === quote) quote = undefined;
+			else if (c === "\\" && quote === '"') i++;
+			else if (quote === '"' && (c === "`" || (c === "$" && text[i + 1] === "("))) return true;
+		} else if (c === "'" || c === '"') quote = c;
+		else if (c === "\\") i++;
+		else if (OPERATOR.test(c === "$" ? text.slice(i, i + 2) : c)) return true;
+	}
+	return false;
+}
+
+/** Drop a leading `cd <dir> &&`, which only sets the working directory. */
+export function stripCd(command: string): string {
+	return command.replace(/^\s*cd\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s;&|]+)\s*&&\s*/, "");
+}
+
+/** The single simple command a line runs, or undefined when it is anything more. */
+export function parse(command: string): Invocation | undefined {
+	const line = stripCd(command).trim();
+	if (!line || hasOperator(line)) return undefined;
+	const words = tokenize(line);
+	if (!words) return undefined;
+	while (words.length && /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=/.test(words[0]!)) words.shift();
+	const first = words.shift();
+	if (!first) return undefined;
+	return { program: first.split("/").pop()!, args: words };
+}
+
+/** Does a short or long flag appear in `args` (also inside combined short flags like -rn)? */
+export function hasFlag(args: string[], long: string[], short: string[] = []): boolean {
+	for (const a of args) {
+		if (a === "--") return false;
+		if (long.includes(a) || long.some((l) => a.startsWith(`${l}=`))) return true;
+		if (/^-[A-Za-z]+$/.test(a) && short.some((s) => a.includes(s))) return true;
+	}
+	return false;
+}

+/** Chooses the compactor for a bash command and applies the safety rules. */
+import { hasFlag, parse } from "./command.ts";
+import { DEFAULT_LIMITS, type Limits, type Squeezed } from "./elide.ts";
+import { compactLsd } from "./lsd.ts";
+import { compactPaths } from "./paths.ts";
+import { compactRg } from "./rg.ts";
+
+export type Kind = "search" | "paths" | "listing";
+
+export type Result = { text: string; kind: Kind; truncated: boolean; before: number; after: number };
+
+export type Options = {
+	limits?: Limits;
+	/** Output shorter than this is never touched. */
+	minChars?: number;
+	/** The result must be at most this share of the original, or the original is kept. */
+	maxRatio?: number;
+	/** Compactors that may run; a missing entry means on. */
+	kinds?: Partial<Record<Kind, boolean>>;
+};
+
+const SEARCH = new Set(["rg", "grep", "egrep", "ugrep"]);
+const PATHS = new Set(["fd", "fdfind", "find"]);
+const LISTING = new Set(["lsd", "eza", "exa"]);
+
+/** Flags after which the output is no longer plain `path:line:text` / one path per line. */
+const NOT_PLAIN_SEARCH = { long: ["--json", "--count", "--files-with-matches", "--files-without-match", "--files", "--heading", "--stats", "--vimgrep", "--only-matching", "--null", "--passthru"], short: ["c", "l", "L", "o", "z"] };
+const NOT_PLAIN_PATHS = { long: ["--exec", "--exec-batch", "--list-details", "--print0", "--format"], short: ["x", "X", "l", "0"] };
+
+function plainFind(args: string[]): boolean {
+	return !args.some((a) => ["-exec", "-execdir", "-ls", "-print0", "-printf", "-fprint", "-delete", "-ok"].includes(a));
+}
+
+function pick(command: string): { kind: Kind; run: (out: string, l: Limits) => Squeezed | undefined } | undefined {
+	const inv = parse(command);
+	if (!inv) return undefined;
+	const { program, args } = inv;
+	if (SEARCH.has(program)) {
+		if (hasFlag(args, NOT_PLAIN_SEARCH.long, NOT_PLAIN_SEARCH.short)) return undefined;
+		return { kind: "search", run: compactRg };
+	}
+	if (PATHS.has(program)) {
+		if (program === "find" ? !plainFind(args) : hasFlag(args, NOT_PLAIN_PATHS.long, NOT_PLAIN_PATHS.short)) return undefined;
+		return { kind: "paths", run: compactPaths };
+	}
+	if (LISTING.has(program)) {
+		if (!hasFlag(args, ["--long"], ["l"])) return undefined;
+		return { kind: "listing", run: compactLsd };
+	}
+	return undefined;
+}
+
+/** True when a native compactor takes care of `command`'s output (whatever the switches say). */
+export const handles = (command: string): boolean => pick(command) !== undefined;
+
+/** Compacts the output of `command`, or returns undefined to leave it exactly as it is. */
+export function compact(command: string, output: string, opts: Options = {}): Result | undefined {
+	const { limits = DEFAULT_LIMITS, minChars = 400, maxRatio = 0.9, kinds = {} } = opts;
+	if (output.length < minChars) return undefined;
+	const chosen = pick(command);
+	if (!chosen || kinds[chosen.kind] === false) return undefined;
+	const sq = chosen.run(output, limits);
+	if (!sq) return undefined;
+	if (sq.text.length > output.length * maxRatio) return undefined;
+	return { text: sq.text, kind: chosen.kind, truncated: sq.truncated, before: output.length, after: sq.text.length };
+}
diff --git a/extensions/core/config.ts b/extensions/core/config.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e24e0e8

@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+/**
+ * The persisted settings: <agent dir>/squeeze.json.
+ *
+ * A hand-edited file can hold anything, so `sanitizeConfig` keeps valid values and defaults the
+ * rest. A missing file is not a problem (defaults); a broken one is reported, never thrown.
+ */
+import { mkdir, readFile, rename, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { homedir } from "node:os";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import type { Kind } from "./compact.ts";
+
+export interface Config {
+	/** Master switch: when false nothing is compacted. */
+	enabled: boolean;
+	/** Show the savings in the status line. */
+	showStatus: boolean;
+	/** Which compactors run. */
+	kinds: Record<Kind, boolean>;
+	/** Rewrite commands to their `rtk` form (git, cargo, docker, …) when the rtk binary is installed. */
+	rtk: boolean;
+	/** Output shorter than this many characters is never touched. */
+	minChars: number;
+	/** Longest line kept whole in search results. */
+	lineChars: number;
+	/** Match lines kept per file. */
+	perGroup: number;
+	/** Lines in a whole compacted result. */
+	total: number;
+}
+
+export const DEFAULT_CONFIG: Config = {
+	enabled: true,
+	showStatus: true,
+	rtk: true,
+	kinds: { search: true, paths: true, listing: true },
+	minChars: 400,
+	lineChars: 240,
+	perGroup: 15,
+	total: 250,
+};
+
+export const clampInt = (v: unknown, min: number, max: number, fallback: number): number =>
+	typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(v))) : fallback;
+
+const bool = (v: unknown, fallback: boolean): boolean => (typeof v === "boolean" ? v : fallback);
+
+export function sanitizeConfig(raw: unknown): Config {
+	const r = (typeof raw === "object" && raw !== null && !Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
+	const k = (typeof r.kinds === "object" && r.kinds !== null ? r.kinds : {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
+	const d = DEFAULT_CONFIG;
+	return {
+		enabled: bool(r.enabled, d.enabled),
+		showStatus: bool(r.showStatus, d.showStatus),
+		rtk: bool(r.rtk, d.rtk),
+		kinds: { search: bool(k.search, d.kinds.search), paths: bool(k.paths, d.kinds.paths), listing: bool(k.listing, d.kinds.listing) },
+		minChars: clampInt(r.minChars, 100, 1_000_000, d.minChars),
+		lineChars: clampInt(r.lineChars, 40, 4000, d.lineChars),
+		perGroup: clampInt(r.perGroup, 1, 500, d.perGroup),
+		total: clampInt(r.total, 20, 5000, d.total),
+	};
+}
+
+/** Where pi keeps its config: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/pi/agent, then ~/.pi/agent. */
+export function resolveAgentDir(env: Record<string, string | undefined>, home: string): string {
+	if (env.PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR) return env.PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR;
+	if (env.XDG_CONFIG_HOME) return join(env.XDG_CONFIG_HOME, "pi", "agent");
+	return join(home, ".pi", "agent");
+}
+
+export const configPath = (env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env, home = homedir()): string =>
+	join(resolveAgentDir(env, home), "squeeze.json");
+
+/** The config, plus a `problem` when the file exists but cannot be used. */
+export async function readConfig(path = configPath()): Promise<{ config: Config; problem?: string }> {
+	let raw: string;
+	try {
+		raw = await readFile(path, "utf8");
+	} catch (e) {
+		const code = (e as { code?: string } | null)?.code;
+		return code === "ENOENT" ? { config: sanitizeConfig({}) } : { config: sanitizeConfig({}), problem: `cannot read ${path} (${code ?? "error"})` };
+	}
+	try {
+		return { config: sanitizeConfig(JSON.parse(raw)) };
+	} catch {
+		return { config: sanitizeConfig({}), problem: `${path} is not valid JSON` };
+	}
+}
+
+export async function loadConfig(path = configPath()): Promise<Config> {
+	return (await readConfig(path)).config;
+}
+
+/** Atomic: written to a temp file and renamed, so a crash or a second pi session never leaves half a file. */
+export async function saveConfig(config: Config, path = configPath()): Promise<void> {
+	await mkdir(join(path, ".."), { recursive: true });
+	const tmp = `${path}.${process.pid}.${Date.now()}.tmp`;
+	try {
+		await writeFile(tmp, `${JSON.stringify(config, null, 2)}\n`, "utf8");
+		await rename(tmp, path);
+	} catch (e) {
+		await Promise.allSettled([rm(tmp, { force: true })]); // the original error matters more
+		throw e;
+	}
+}
+
+/** The compaction options this config stands for. */
+export function optionsOf(c: Config) {
+	return { limits: { lineChars: c.lineChars, perGroup: c.perGroup, total: c.total }, minChars: c.minChars, kinds: c.kinds };
+}
diff --git a/extensions/core/elide.ts b/extensions/core/elide.ts

+++ b/extensions/core/elide.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+/** Shared limits and truncation helpers: every cut leaves a visible marker behind. */
+
+export type Limits = {
+	/** Longest line kept whole; longer ones are cut with a note. */
+	lineChars: number;
+	/** Lines kept per file or group. */
+	perGroup: number;
+	/** Lines in the whole result. */
+	total: number;
+};
+
+export const DEFAULT_LIMITS: Limits = { lineChars: 240, perGroup: 15, total: 250 };
+
+export type Squeezed = {
+	text: string;
+	/** True when content was left out (not merely reformatted): the full output is worth saving. */
+	truncated: boolean;
+};
+
+export function cutLine(line: string, max: number): string {
+	if (line.length <= max) return line;
+	return `${line.slice(0, max)}… [+${line.length - max} chars]`;
+}
+
+/** Caps `lines` at `total`, replacing the rest with a one-line marker. */
+export function capLines(lines: string[], total: number): Squeezed {
+	if (lines.length <= total) return { text: lines.join("\n"), truncated: false };
+	const kept = lines.slice(0, total);
+	kept.push(`… [+${lines.length - total} more lines]`);
+	return { text: kept.join("\n"), truncated: true };
+}
diff --git a/extensions/core/lsd.ts b/extensions/core/lsd.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f184644

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+/**
+ * `lsd -l` / `eza -l` style listings reduced to what a model uses: type, size, modified
+ * time (no year or seconds) and name. Owner, group and permission bits are dropped.
+ *
+ *   d  Oct 24 16:40  command
+ *   -  6.0KB  Oct 24 16:40  tokenburn.ts
+ *
+ * Strict: a single line that does not parse makes it return undefined.
+ */
+import { capLines, DEFAULT_LIMITS, type Limits, type Squeezed } from "./elide.ts";
+
+const ROW = /^([dl.\-bcps])[rwxsStT\-.+@]{9}\S*\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+([\d.,]+ ?[A-Za-z]*)\s+(\w{3}) (\w{3})\s+(\d+) (\d\d:\d\d):\d\d \d{4}\s+(.+)$/;
+
+export function compactLsd(output: string, limits: Limits = DEFAULT_LIMITS): Squeezed | undefined {
+	const lines = output.split("\n");
+	while (lines.length && lines.at(-1) === "") lines.pop();
+	if (lines.length < 3) return undefined;
+	const out: string[] = [];
+	for (const l of lines) {
+		const m = ROW.exec(l);
+		if (!m) return undefined;
+		const [, kind, size, , month, day, time, name] = m;
+		if (name === "." || name === "..") continue;
+		const type = kind === "d" ? "d" : kind === "l" ? "l" : "-";
+		const meta = type === "d" ? "" : `${size!.replace(/\s+/g, "")}  `;
+		out.push(`${type}  ${meta}${month} ${day} ${time}  ${name}`);
+	}
+	return capLines(out, limits.total);
+}
diff --git a/extensions/core/paths.ts b/extensions/core/paths.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..560a1ee
--- /dev/null
+++ b/extensions/core/paths.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+/**
+ * `fd` / `find` output (one path per line) grouped by directory:
+ *
+ *   src/core/
+ *     a.ts b.ts c.ts
+ *
+ * Names with spaces are quoted. A directory with a single entry keeps its full path.
+ */
+import { capLines, DEFAULT_LIMITS, type Limits, type Squeezed } from "./elide.ts";
+
+function split(path: string): [string, string] {
+	const dir = path.endsWith("/");
+	const body = dir ? path.slice(0, -1) : path;
+	const i = body.lastIndexOf("/");
+	if (i < 0) return ["", path];
+	return [body.slice(0, i + 1), body.slice(i + 1) + (dir ? "/" : "")];
+}
+
+export function compactPaths(output: string, limits: Limits = DEFAULT_LIMITS): Squeezed | undefined {
+	const lines = output.split("\n");
+	while (lines.length && lines.at(-1) === "") lines.pop();
+	if (lines.length < 2 || lines.some((l) => l === "" || l.includes("\t"))) return undefined;
+
+	const groups = new Map<string, string[]>();
+	for (const l of lines) {
+		const [dir, name] = split(l);
+		const g = groups.get(dir);
+		if (g) g.push(name);
+		else groups.set(dir, [name]);
+	}
+	const out: string[] = [];
+	for (const [dir, names] of groups) {
+		if (names.length === 1) {
+			out.push(`${dir}${names[0]}`);
+			continue;
+		}
+		out.push(dir || "./");
+		const quoted = names.map((n) => (/\s/.test(n) ? JSON.stringify(n) : n));
+		let row = "  ";
+		for (const n of quoted) {
+			if (row.length + n.length > 100 && row.trim()) {
+				out.push(row.trimEnd());
+				row = "  ";
+			}
+			row += `${n} `;
+		}
+		if (row.trim()) out.push(row.trimEnd());
+	}
+	return capLines(out, limits.total);
+}
diff --git a/extensions/core/rg.ts b/extensions/core/rg.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e6c0803
--- /dev/null
+++ b/extensions/core/rg.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,89 @@
+/**
+ * `rg -n` / `grep -n` output (`path:line:text`, context lines `path-line-text`) grouped by
+ * file, so each path is written once instead of on every match:
+ *
+ *   src/a.ts (3)
+ *     12: const x = 1;
+ *     13- context
+ *
+ * Strict: when any line is not in that format (`--heading`, `-c`, `-l`, `--json`, no
+ * line numbers) it returns undefined and the output passes through unchanged.
+ */
+import { cutLine, DEFAULT_LIMITS, type Limits, type Squeezed } from "./elide.ts";
+
+type Row = { path: string; line: number; sep: ":" | "-"; text: string };
+
+const MATCH = /^(.+?):(\d+):(.*)$/;
+
+export function parseRows(output: string): Row[] | undefined {
+	const lines = output.split("\n");
+	while (lines.length && lines.at(-1) === "") lines.pop();
+	if (!lines.length) return undefined;
+	const rows: Row[] = [];
+	const files = new Set<string>();
+	const pending: { index: number; raw: string }[] = [];
+	for (const raw of lines) {
+		if (raw === "--") continue;
+		const m = MATCH.exec(raw);
+		if (m) {
+			if (m[1]!.includes(":")) return undefined; // `12:foo:3:bar` is single-file output, not a path
+			files.add(m[1]!);
+			rows.push({ path: m[1]!, line: Number(m[2]), sep: ":", text: m[3]! });
+		} else {
+			pending.push({ index: rows.length, raw });
+			rows.push(undefined as unknown as Row);
+		}
+	}
+	if (!files.size) return undefined;
+	// Context lines (`path-line-text`) only count for files that also had a real match.
+	for (const { index, raw } of pending) {
+		let row: Row | undefined;
+		for (const path of files) {
+			if (!raw.startsWith(`${path}-`)) continue;
+			const m = /^(\d+)-(.*)$/.exec(raw.slice(path.length + 1));
+			if (m) {
+				row = { path, line: Number(m[1]), sep: "-", text: m[2]! };
+				break;
+			}
+		}
+		if (!row) return undefined;
+		rows[index] = row;
+	}
+	return rows;
+}
+
+export function compactRg(output: string, limits: Limits = DEFAULT_LIMITS): Squeezed | undefined {
+	const rows = parseRows(output);
+	if (!rows) return undefined;
+	const groups = new Map<string, Row[]>();
+	for (const r of rows) {
+		const g = groups.get(r.path);
+		if (g) g.push(r);
+		else groups.set(r.path, [r]);
+	}
+	const matchCount = rows.filter((r) => r.sep === ":").length;
+	const out: string[] = [`${matchCount} matches in ${groups.size} files`];
+	let truncated = false;
+	let hiddenFiles = 0;
+	for (const [path, list] of groups) {
+		if (out.length >= limits.total) {
+			hiddenFiles++;
+			truncated = true;
+			continue;
+		}
+		const matches = list.filter((r) => r.sep === ":").length;
+		out.push(`${path} (${matches})`);
+		let shown = 0;
+		for (const r of list) {
+			if (shown >= limits.perGroup) break;
+			out.push(`  ${r.line}${r.sep} ${cutLine(r.text.trim(), limits.lineChars)}`);
+			shown++;
+		}
+		if (list.length > shown) {
+			out.push(`  … [+${list.length - shown} more in this file]`);
+			truncated = true;
+		}
+	}
+	if (hiddenFiles) out.push(`… [+${hiddenFiles} more files]`);
+	return { text: out.join("\n"), truncated };
+}
diff --git a/extensions/core/rtk.ts b/extensions/core/rtk.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cbb883d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/extensions/core/rtk.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+/**
+ * The optional rtk layer: commands that have no native compactor here (git, cargo, docker, …) are
+ * rewritten to their `rtk` form, which prints a compact output itself.
+ *
+ * `rtk rewrite <command>` is the single source of truth for what rtk can take over. Exit 0 and 3
+ * mean "rewritten" (3: the host should ask for approval, pi has no such step); 1 means no rewrite
+ * and 2 a deny. Never rewritten: what a native compactor handles (its output format is ours to
+ * parse) and file reads (`rtk read` may drop lines, and a read must stay exact).
+ */
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { handles } from "./compact.ts";
+
+export type Run = (command: string) => { status: number | null; stdout: string; missing?: boolean };
+
+const spawnRun: Run = (command) => {
+	const r = spawnSync("rtk", ["rewrite", command], { encoding: "utf8", timeout: 2000 });
+	return { status: r.status, stdout: r.stdout ?? "", missing: (r.error as NodeJS.ErrnoException | undefined)?.code === "ENOENT" };
+};
+
+let run: Run = spawnRun;
+/** For tests: replace the process runner (no argument restores it). */
+export const useRunner = (r: Run = spawnRun): void => {
+	run = r;
+};
+
+const cache = new Map<string, string | undefined>();
+const CACHE_MAX = 500;
+let missing = false;
+
+/** The command to run instead of `command`, or undefined to run it as written. */
+export function rewrite(command: string): string | undefined {
+	if (missing || command.trim() === "" || handles(command)) return undefined;
+	if (cache.has(command)) return cache.get(command);
+	const r = run(command);
+	if (r.missing) {
+		missing = true;
+		return undefined;
+	}
+	const out = r.stdout.trim();
+	const rewritten = (r.status === 0 || r.status === 3) && out !== "" && out !== command && !/^rtk read\b/.test(out) ? out : undefined;
+	if (cache.size >= CACHE_MAX) cache.clear();
+	cache.set(command, rewritten);
+	return rewritten;
+}
+
+/** For tests: forget what was learned (the cache and a missing binary). */
+export function resetRtk(): void {
+	cache.clear();
+	missing = false;
+}

+import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+
+/** Writes the untouched output to a temp file so a truncated result can be recovered. */
+export function saveFull(text: string, dir = join(tmpdir(), "pi-squeeze")): string {
+	mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
+	const path = join(dir, `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}.txt`);
+	writeFileSync(path, text);
+	return path;
+}
diff --git a/extensions/core/stats.ts b/extensions/core/stats.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cf15476
--- /dev/null
+++ b/extensions/core/stats.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import type { Kind, Result } from "./compact.ts";
+
+export type Stats = { calls: number; before: number; after: number; byKind: Record<Kind, { calls: number; saved: number }> };
+
+export function emptyStats(): Stats {
+	return { calls: 0, before: 0, after: 0, byKind: { search: { calls: 0, saved: 0 }, paths: { calls: 0, saved: 0 }, listing: { calls: 0, saved: 0 } } };
+}
+
+export function record(stats: Stats, r: Result): void {
+	stats.calls++;
+	stats.before += r.before;
+	stats.after += r.after;
+	stats.byKind[r.kind].calls++;
+	stats.byKind[r.kind].saved += r.before - r.after;
+}
+
+/** Characters saved so far. */
+export const saved = (s: Stats): number => s.before - s.after;
+
+/** Rough token estimate: 4 characters per token. */
+export const tokens = (chars: number): number => Math.round(chars / 4);
+
+export function summary(stats: Stats): string {
+	if (!stats.calls) return "squeeze: nothing compacted yet in this session";
+	const pct = Math.round((saved(stats) / stats.before) * 100);
+	const kinds = (Object.entries(stats.byKind) as [Kind, { calls: number; saved: number }][])
+		.filter(([, v]) => v.calls)
+		.map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v.calls}× (~${tokens(v.saved)} tokens)`)
+		.join(", ");
+	return `squeeze: ${stats.calls} outputs compacted, ~${tokens(saved(stats))} tokens saved (${pct}%): ${kinds}`;
+}

+type StatusUi = { ui: { setStatus(key: string, text: string): void } };
+
+export const settingsText = (c: Config): string =>
+	`${c.enabled ? "on" : "off"} · rtk ${c.rtk ? "on" : "off"} · search ${c.kinds.search ? "on" : "off"} · paths ${c.kinds.paths ? "on" : "off"} · listing ${c.kinds.listing ? "on" : "off"} · min ${c.minChars} chars`;
 
 export default function (pi: ExtensionAPI) {
+	let config: Config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, kinds: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.kinds } };
+	const stats = emptyStats();
+	if (process.env.PI_SQUEEZE === "off") config.enabled = false;
+
+	const showStatus = (ctx: StatusUi) => {
+		const n = tokens(saved(stats));
+		ctx.ui.setStatus("squeeze", config.enabled && config.showStatus && n > 0 ? `squeeze: ~${n >= 1000 ? `${(n / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : n} tokens saved` : "");
+	};
+
+	pi.on("session_start", async (_event, ctx) => {
+		const { config: loaded, problem } = await readConfig();
+		config = loaded;
+		if (process.env.PI_SQUEEZE === "off") config.enabled = false;
+		if (problem) ctx.ui.notify(`squeeze: ${problem}; using the defaults`, "warning");
+		showStatus(ctx);
+	});
+
+	pi.on("tool_call", async (event) => {
+		if (!config.enabled || !config.rtk || event.toolName !== "bash") return;
+		const input = event.input as { command?: unknown };
+		if (typeof input.command !== "string") return;
+		const rewritten = rewrite(input.command);
+		if (rewritten) input.command = rewritten;
+	});
+
+	pi.on("tool_result", async (event, ctx) => {
+		if (!config.enabled || event.toolName !== "bash" || event.isError) return;
+		const command = (event.input as { command?: unknown }).command;
+		if (typeof command !== "string") return;
+		// pi already truncated this one: its text is not the tool's own format any more.
+		if ((event.details as { truncation?: unknown } | undefined)?.truncation) return;
+		const blocks = event.content;
+		if (blocks.length !== 1 || blocks[0]!.type !== "text") return;
+		const original = blocks[0]!.text;
+
+		const r = compact(command, original, optionsOf(config));
+		if (!r) return;
+		record(stats, r);
+		showStatus(ctx);
+		const text = r.truncated ? `${r.text}\n[squeeze: output shortened; full output: ${saveFull(original)}]` : r.text;
+		return { content: [{ type: "text", text }] };
+	});
+
 	pi.registerCommand("squeeze", {
-		description: "Say hello (sample command)",
+		description: "pi-squeeze: status, on, off, search|paths|listing|rtk on|off, min <chars>",
+		getArgumentCompletions: (prefix: string) => completions(prefix),
 		handler: async (args, ctx) => {
-			ctx.ui.notify(greet(args), "info");
+			const cmd = parseCommand(args);
+			// The setting applies to this session either way; a failed save only means it is not remembered.
+			const persist = async () => {
+				try {
+					await saveConfig(config);
+				} catch (error) {
+					ctx.ui.notify(`squeeze: could not save the setting (${(error as Error)?.message ?? String(error)}); it applies to this session only`, "warning");
+				}
+				showStatus(ctx);
+			};
+			switch (cmd.kind) {
+				case "status":
+					ctx.ui.notify(`squeeze ${settingsText(config)}\n${summary(stats)}`, "info");
+					return;
+				case "on":
+				case "off":
+					config.enabled = cmd.kind === "on";
+					await persist();
+					ctx.ui.notify(`squeeze ${cmd.kind}`, "info");
+					return;
+				case "rtk":
+					config.rtk = cmd.on;
+					await persist();
+					ctx.ui.notify(`squeeze: rtk ${cmd.on ? "on" : "off"}`, "info");
+					return;
+				case "compactor":
+					config.kinds[cmd.compactor] = cmd.on;
+					await persist();
+					ctx.ui.notify(`squeeze: ${cmd.compactor} ${cmd.on ? "on" : "off"}`, "info");
+					return;
+				case "min":
+					config.minChars = cmd.chars;
+					await persist();
+					ctx.ui.notify(`squeeze: output under ${cmd.chars} characters is left alone`, "info");
+					return;
+				case "invalid":
+					ctx.ui.notify(cmd.message, "warning");
+					return;
+			}
 		},
 	});
 }

+			const ev = call("git status");
+			await hooks.tool_call!(ev, fakeCtx()); // the real process: rewritten if rtk is installed, else untouched
+			expect(["git status", "rtk git status"]).toContain(ev.input.command as string);
+		});
 	});
 });
